exact.אין צורך לשלוח כל הזמן בקשות שדרוג - יש: There's no need to keep sending upgrade requests — there are clear rules for it. You earn reputation from several sources: 5 reputation for every private app you uploaded that was approved, 5 reputation for every approved public suggestion, and 2 reputation for every download of an app you uploaded by another user (up to a daily limit, to prevent abuse). As soon as you accumulate 300 reputation in total, the account is automatically upgraded to PRO — no need to ask at all. You can also request a manual upgrade from the team, but it's considered at their discretion and isn't guaranteed.
exact.בעמוד הפרופיל יש לכל משתמש קישור הזמנה א: On the profile page, every user has a personal invite link (with their username). Every new friend who signs up through this link and verifies their email earns you 25 reputation plus a one-time credit to upload a file of up to 150MB (credits accumulate — one credit per successful referral). The friend who signed up also receives 10 reputation as a gift. To keep things fair: up to 5 referrals are rewarded per rolling 24 hours, and a sign-up coming from the same network/device as the referrer can't be rewarded — such a referral is still recorded, just without reputation. Attempting to fake referrals (opening fictitious accounts) will be considered abuse and may lead to an account ban.
